name: file_split
description: Split a text file into pieces of N lines (split -l): chunks x<aa> in <file>.parts/, root-confined. Lines only.

file.description: text file to split, relative to the project root

lines.description: lines per piece (required — count/byte splits are refused)

outdir.description: output directory for the chunks (default <file>.parts next to the source; must stay inside the project)
